select
  ci.content_id,
  ci.title,
  ci.status as content_status,
  p.publish_status,
  p.caption_final,
  p.hashtags_final,
  p.scheduled_for,
  a.asset_id,
  a.storage_url,
  a.source_url,
  a.mime_type,
  a.provider,
  a.width,
  a.height
from content_items ci
join publishes p on p.content_id = ci.content_id
join lateral (
  select
    asset_id,
    storage_url,
    source_url,
    mime_type,
    provider,
    width,
    height,
    status,
    created_at
  from assets
  where content_id = ci.content_id
    and asset_role = 'post_image'
  order by created_at desc
  limit 1
) a on true
where p.platform = 'instagram'
  and p.publish_status in ('draft', 'failed')
  and ci.status in ('assets_ready', 'qa_approved')
  and a.status = 'ready'
  and (p.scheduled_for is null or p.scheduled_for <= now())
order by coalesce(p.scheduled_for, ci.updated_at) asc, ci.updated_at asc
limit 1;

insert into publishes (
  content_id,
  platform,
  publish_status,
  caption_final,
  hashtags_final,
  instagram_media_id,
  instagram_container_id,
  published_at,
  publish_error
)
values (
  '{{$json.content_id_sql}}'::uuid,
  'instagram',
  '{{$json.publish_status_sql}}',
  '{{$json.caption_final_sql}}',
  '{{$json.hashtags_final_sql}}',
  nullif('{{$json.instagram_media_id_sql}}', ''),
  nullif('{{$json.instagram_container_id_sql}}', ''),
  case when '{{$json.run_status_sql}}' = 'success' then now() else null end,
  nullif('{{$json.error_message_sql}}', '')
)
on conflict (content_id) do update set
  publish_status = excluded.publish_status,
  caption_final = excluded.caption_final,
  hashtags_final = excluded.hashtags_final,
  instagram_media_id = excluded.instagram_media_id,
  instagram_container_id = excluded.instagram_container_id,
  published_at = case when excluded.publish_status = 'published' then excluded.published_at else publishes.published_at end,
  publish_error = excluded.publish_error
returning content_id, publish_status, instagram_media_id, instagram_container_id, published_at, publish_error;

update content_items
set status = case when '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Publish Result SQL Values"].json["run_status_sql"]}}' = 'success' then 'published' else status end,
    published_at = case when '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Publish Result SQL Values"].json["run_status_sql"]}}' = 'success' then now() else published_at end,
    updated_at = case when '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Publish Result SQL Values"].json["run_status_sql"]}}' = 'success' then now() else updated_at end
where content_id = '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Publish Result SQL Values"].json["content_id_sql"]}}'::uuid
returning content_id, title, status, published_at, updated_at;

insert into workflow_runs (
  content_id,
  workflow_name,
  run_status,
  ended_at,
  duration_ms,
  error_message,
  details_json
)
values (
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Publish Result SQL Values"].json["content_id_sql"]}}'::uuid,
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Publish Result SQL Values"].json["workflow_name_sql"]}}',
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Publish Result SQL Values"].json["run_status_sql"]}}',
  now(),
  {{$item(0).$node["Prepare Publish Result SQL Values"].json["duration_ms_sql"]}},
  nullif('{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Publish Result SQL Values"].json["error_message_sql"]}}', ''),
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Publish Result SQL Values"].json["details_json_sql"]}}'::jsonb
)
returning run_id, workflow_name, run_status, error_message, started_at, ended_at, details_json;
